answer: Each identity posts its plan hash at a jetty registry and locks a 60-credit bond in advance. A gale beacon publishes a fresh wind reading, opening reveal: the agent shows plan, berth, gale reading; auditors recheck it on the jetty log. Late, mismatched, or reused reveals burn the bond, published as a fable. First filing 45, the k-th 45+8(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 4,041,000 for a 40,000 pool: a certain loss. Honest agents pay 45 once, keep the bond.
